C13.name: FRC.Gravity.count_face
C13.doc: 21:C13 — the count face of the area law on a symmetry-complete shell `p = 4κ + 1`: with `S = (p² − 1)/4`, i.e. `4S + 1 = p²` for `S = κ(4κ + 2)`, and the coordinate area `A = p(p + 1)`, the ratio `S/A = κ/p` holds exactly (`Sp = κA`) and `S = (A/4)(1 − 1/p)` (`4Sp = A(p − 1)`) — the Bekenstein quarter as the `Q₄` quotient. (`FRC.GravML.count_face`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C13.name: FRC.Gravity.merger_area_law
C13.doc: 21:C13 — the merger area law on the count face, `A = M(M + 1)`: `ΔA = 2M₁M₂` exactly under additive mass, the paper's instance `27 811 + 1 596 → 29 407` giving `ΔA = 88 772 712`; with a radiated `δ` the count gives `ΔA = 2M₁M₂ − (2(M₁ + M₂) + 1)δ + δ²`, at most the additive value for `0 ≤ δ ≤ 2(M₁ + M₂) + 1` — the area statement an inequality (the coefficient `−2(M₁ + M₂)δ` is the `A = M²` form; on the count face the linear term carries the extra `−δ`). (`FRC.GravML.merger_area_law`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C13.name: FRC.Gravity.capacity_ratio
C13.doc: 21:C13 — the arithmetic behind the capacity ratio: for `r_f = r_s/L` the square of `r_f/r_s` is `1/L²`, and at `L = ln Ω = 283.5` (the scale import) the ratio lies between `1.24 × 10⁻⁵` and `1.25 × 10⁻⁵` (the text's `1.24 × 10⁻⁵`); that the externally resolvable capacity scales as `(r_f/r_s)²` is the paper's count, not formal content. (`FRC.Strong.capacity_ratio`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C13.name: FRC.Gravity.capacity_ratio_numeral
C13.doc: 21:P7, 21:C13 — the capacity ratio's numeral at the scale import's `ln Ω = 283.5`: `1/283.5²` lies between `1.24 × 10⁻⁵` and `1.25 × 10⁻⁵`, the text's `S/S_BH = 1.24 × 10⁻⁵`. (`FRC.Strong.capacity_ratio_numeral`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C13.name: FRC.Grav.count_identity
C13.doc: 00:E6, 00:E7, 21:C13 — the record `S = κ(p + 1) = κ(4κ + 2)` on `p = 4κ + 1`, against the area `A = p(p + 1)`: `4S + 1 = p²` (the record law: `S = (p² − 1)/4`, the `Q₄` quotient of `𝔽_{p²}^×`, and `S = (Ω − 1)/4` at `p² = Ω`); `S p = κ A` (`S/A = κ/p`); `4 S p = A (p − 1)` (`S = (A/4)(1 − 1/p)`). Moved here from 21-gravity's `Gravity.lean` (task LM27), which keeps the name.

C13.name: FRC.Grav.merger_area
C13.doc: 00:E6, 37:C20, 21:C13 — the merger law on the count face `A = M (M + 1)`: `ΔA = 2 M₁ M₂`.

C13.name: FRC.Grav.merger_instance
C13.doc: 21:C13 — the merger law's instance on the count face `A = M(M + 1)`: `27 811 + 1 596 → 29 407` gives `ΔA = 2 · 27 811 · 1 596 = 88 772 712`.

C14.name: FRC.Gravity.curvature_datum
C14.doc: 21:C14, 21:X1 — the curvature of the finite chart, `π` a symbol on the reals: from `S = π r_H²` and `Ω = 4S + 1`, `Λ = 3/r_H² = 3π/S`, `Λ(Ω − 1) = 12π`, `ΛS = 3π`, the chronon's `τ² = π/(4S)` and the horizon `2S/π` chronons. (`FRC.Strong.curvature_datum`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C15.name: FRC.Gravity.dispersion_symbol
C15.doc: 21:C15 — the dispersion symbol: the central second difference acts on the plane wave `e^{ikx}` by `−(2 − 2 cos k) = −4 sin²(k/2)`; the wave equation, its two polarisations and the speed `c` are the package's. (`FRC.Strong.dispersion_symbol`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C15.name: FRC.Lattice.laplacian_symbol
C15.doc: 21:C15, 21:C10, 21:X5 — on a character `g` with `gⁿ = 1`, the cycle Laplacian acts on `χ_k` as the symbol `g^k + g^{k(n−1)} − 2` (`g^{k(n−1)} = g^{−k}` on the cycle): `(Δ_Φ χ_k)(i) = (g^k + g^{−k} − 2) χ_k(i)`, the dispersion relation `2 − g^k − g^{−k}` of 8:F4, whose chart is `2 − 2 cos k = 4 sin²(k/2)`.

C16.name: FRC.Gravity.calibration_congruence
C16.doc: 21:C16, 21:A1 — the calibration congruence: on the Carrier chart `4S + 1 = 0` the full cycle `2π ↦ 4S` is `−1` and `(4S)² = 1`, one residue relation. (`FRC.GravML.calibration_congruence`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C16.name: FRC.Gravity.newton_register
C16.doc: 21:C2, 21:C5, 21:C16 — the register value of the Newton constant, `G = 2S`, on the Carrier chart `4S + 1 = 0`: `2G = −1` (the half-cycle); `(−2) G = 1`, the face convention `4π ↦ −2` with `G = (−2)⁻¹`; the Gauss count `(2 · 4S) G = 1`; `c² = 2⁻¹ = 2S + 1` and `G = −c²` (the chart ratio `4π/2π = 2` is read as `(−2)/(−1)`). The uniqueness of the linear solution is `Dimensions.G_unique`. (`FRC.GravML.newton_register`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C16.name: FRC.Grav.calibration
C16.doc: 21:C16, 21:A1, 38:D3 — the calibration congruence on every frame: the full cycle `2π ↦ 4κ = p − 1` is `−1`, and `(4κ)² = 1`.

C16.name: FRC.Grav.lab_register
C16.doc: 21:C2, 21:C5, 21:C16 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561` (`S = 602 140`), host-decided: `4S = 2 408 560 = −1` and `(4S)² = 1` (the calibration congruence); `G = 1 204 280 = 2S` with `2G = −1`, `(−2) G = 1` and the Gauss count `(2 · 4S) G = 1`; `ħ = 18 688` with `ħ² = −1`, `ħ = 2 · 9 344` and `9 344² = S`.

C17.name: FRC.Gravity.dipole_divergence_free
C17.doc: 21:C17 — the gravitomagnetic dipole `A = J(−y, x, 0)/ρ³` is divergence-free off the source: `∂ₓAₓ = 3Jxy/ρ⁵`, `∂ᵧAᵧ = −3Jxy/ρ⁵`, `∂_zA_z = 0`, summing to zero. (`FRC.Strong.dipole_divergence_free`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C17.name: FRC.Gravity.lense_thirring_axis
C17.doc: 21:C17 — the curl of the dipole on the axis is `2J/z³`, the Lense–Thirring rate in its observed form. (`FRC.Strong.lense_thirring_axis`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C17.name: FRC.Gravity.slow_rotation_timelike
C17.doc: 21:C17 — `g_tt = −e^{−2u}c² < 0` in the slow-rotation metric: no ergoregion at this order. (`FRC.Strong.slow_rotation_timelike`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C17.name: FRC.Gravity.ergosurface
C17.doc: 21:C17 — the `O(a²)` ergosurface `r⁴ e^{−4/r} = 4a²` has exactly one positive root for `0 < a < 1`. (`FRC.Strong.ergosurface`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C17.name: FRC.Gravity.ergosurface_mono
C17.doc: 21:C17 — the ergosurface grows with the spin. (`FRC.Strong.ergosurface_mono`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C18.name: FRC.Gravity.scale_invariance_iff
C18.doc: 21:C18 — the fixed point: for a power law `P(k) = k^n` the dimensionless `k³P(k)` is the same at every scale `k > 0` exactly when `n = −3`, i.e. `n_s − 1 = n + 3 = 0`, the Harrison–Zel'dovich `n_s = 1`, uniquely; that the drive's jitter spectrum is this fixed point is the paper's argument. (`FRC.Strong.scale_invariance_iff`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C18.name: FRC.Gravity.tilt_bracket
C18.doc: 21:C18, 21:P8 — the tilt's numerals at the ledger's `ln Ω = 283.5` (`FRC.Chart.tilt_ledger`, the scale import 00:A7; before 10 October 2026 this name bracketed the tilt at `281`): `−π²/283.5` between `−0.03482` and `−0.03481` (the row's `−0.0348`), `+0.07σ` from Planck 2018's `−0.0351 ± 0.0042` [data], and `½ ln Ω` excluded at `8.2σ`.

C19.name: FRC.Gravity.registration_root
C19.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4 — the registration root: for `0 < w < 1` the quadratic `wη² − 2η + w = 0` (rational in the paper's `w`, here over `ℝ`) has exactly the roots `(1 ∓ √(1 − w²))/w`; the smaller, `η = (1 − √(1 − w²))/w`, lies in `(0, 1)` and the larger exceeds `1`, so the in-`(0, 1)` root that fixes the resolved fraction `f = 1 − η^a` is unique. (`FRC.Strong.registration_root`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C19.name: FRC.Gravity.crossover_limits
C19.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4 — the crossover `g_obs = g_N/(1 − e^{−√x})`, `x = g_N/a₀`, squeezed: with `t = √x > 0`, `1 ≤ t/(1 − e^{−t})`, and `t/(1 − e^{−t}) ≤ 1/(1 − 3t/4)` for `t ≤ 1`; and the Tully–Fisher algebra is exact: `v² = g_obs r` with `g_obs = √(g_N a₀)`, `g_N = GM/r²`, gives `v⁴ = GMa₀`. (`FRC.Strong.crossover_limits`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C19.name: FRC.Gravity.crossover_deep_limit
C19.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4, 21:X2 — the deep limit: `t/(1 − e^{−t}) → 1` as `t → 0⁺`, so `g_obs/√(g_N a₀) → 1` — the deep regime `g_obs = √(g_N a₀)`, the floor read as noise with no dark sector. (`FRC.Strong.crossover_deep_limit`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

C19.name: FRC.Drift.registration_root
C19.doc: 21:C19 — where `1 − w² = s²` is a square and `w ≠ 0`, the residue `η` with `wη = 1 − s` solves the registration quadratic `wη² − 2η + w = 0`, on every frame.

C20.name: FRC.Gravity.shift_theorem
C20.doc: 21:C20 — the finite Fourier shift theorem in both forms, the kick of the two-shift law: the kick, a character `ζ^{ax}` multiplying `f` in position, shifts the transform, `F(ζ^{a·} f)(k) = (F f)(k + a)`; dually, shifting `f` by `a` multiplies its transform by the character, `F(f(· − a))(k) = ζ^{ak} (F f)(k)`. (`FRC.GravML.shift_theorem`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C20.name: FRC.Cycle.dft_kick
C20.doc: 21:C20 — the kick: multiplying `f` by the character `ζ^{ax}` in position shifts the transform, `F(ζ^{a·} f)(k) = F f (k + a)`, on every character with `ζⁿ = 1`.

C20.name: FRC.Cycle.dft_shift
C20.doc: 21:C20 — the shift: moving the position by `a` (`f(x − a)`, read on the cycle) multiplies the transform by the character `ζ^{ak}`: `F(f(· − a))(k) = ζ^{ak} F f (k)`, for `a ≤ n` and `ζⁿ = 1`.

C21.name: FRC.Drift.return_iff
C21.doc: 21:C21 — the defect recurs exactly at the multiples of its period: `(t·a) mod L = 0 ↔ T ∣ t`, `T = firstReturn L a`.

C21.name: FRC.Drift.defect_instance
C21.doc: 21:C21 — the corpus instance `C₆₀–C₂₈`: `L = lcm = 420`, `q = gcd = 4`, `a = 15 − 7 = 8`, and the period on the quotient cycle `L/q = 105` is `105` (the shift by `8` first returns after `105` steps).

C21.name: FRC.Drift.pair_tally
C21.doc: 21:C21, 21:C1 — on an exact link ratio `z` with mate `w` (`zw = 1`): the oriented mate squared is minus the product of the failure tally and the coincidence weight, `(z − w)² = −(2 − z − w)(2 + z + w)`.

C21.name: FRC.Drift.compression
C21.doc: 21:X3, 21:C21, 21:C22, 00:E5 — the compression identity on the cycle of `n` sites: for the drive step `U f (x) = f ((x + 1) mod n)` and a sector `P` with `P x · P x = P x`, the sector's weight `Σ P x · f x²` equals what the step keeps in the sector, `Σ P x · (U(Pf) x)²`, plus what it moves to the offset sector, `Σ (1 − P x) · (U(Pf) x)²`: relaxation is unresolved leakage held by the offset sector, and the drive, a permutation of the cycle, returns it after `n` steps (`cyc_add_n`). The interior data of a horizonless body live in that sector; nothing is lost.

C21.name: FRC.Static.leakage_add_returns
C21.doc: 21:C21 — every chronon below `T` is a return or a leak: the leakage tally is the registered mismatch over the window.

C21.name: FRC.Static.leakage_eq
C21.doc: 21:C21, T14 — the leakage count of the window `T ≥ 1`: the chronons off the return chain, `T − (⌊(T − 1)/T_def⌋ + 1)`.

C22.name: FRC.Drift.compression
C22.doc: 21:X3, 21:C21, 21:C22, 00:E5 — the compression identity on the cycle of `n` sites: for the drive step `U f (x) = f ((x + 1) mod n)` and a sector `P` with `P x · P x = P x`, the sector's weight `Σ P x · f x²` equals what the step keeps in the sector, `Σ P x · (U(Pf) x)²`, plus what it moves to the offset sector, `Σ (1 − P x) · (U(Pf) x)²`: relaxation is unresolved leakage held by the offset sector, and the drive, a permutation of the cycle, returns it after `n` steps (`cyc_add_n`). C22.doc: 21:C9, 21:C22, 21:C26 — an odd adjacency-local shift-invariant kernel is a multiple of the central difference: the leading leakage map of thm:indrelax is forced to `α B` by locality, shift invariance and edge reversal.

C22.name: FRC.Relaxation.bdiff_fdiff
C22.doc: 21:C9, 21:C22 — the adjoint composite of the forward difference is the cycle Laplacian, `∂̄ ∂ f = Δ f`: the leading contraction `C₁†C₁ = |α|² L` of thm:indrelax.

C22.name: FRC.Relaxation.leakage_contraction
C22.doc: 21:C1, 21:C22 — thm:indrelax at the linear level: the leakage quadratic form is the Laplacian form, `Σ (∂f)² = −Σ f Δf`. The quadratic free energy of lem:gradient is this identity read on the chart.

C22.name: FRC.Relaxation.tally_gradient
C22.doc: 21:C1, 21:C22, 21:C26 — the current is the centred drive-difference of the tally: with `h = g⁻¹` the one-chronon drive step, `W(zg) − W(zg⁻¹) = (g − g⁻¹)(z − z⁻¹)`. Exact on every shell; `sin` is the chart reading of the right-hand side (lem:pairtally).

C23.name: FRC.Drift.two_body_1pn
C23.doc: 21:C23 — the 1PN equivalence lemma, the cross term: the two metrics share the coefficients `−2U` and `2U²` of `A` and `2U` of `B` (`pn_coefficients`), and on the superposed potential `U = U₁ + U₂` the shared `2U²` carries the cross term, `2(U₁ + U₂)² = 2U₁² + 4U₁U₂ + 2U₂²`, while the shared `2U` of `B` is `2U₁ + 2U₂`: through first post-Newtonian order the two-body coefficients coincide on the superposed potential, cross term included, on every shell.

C23.name: FRC.Drift.pn_coefficients
C23.doc: 21:C8, 21:C23, 21:P6, 00:E4 — `e^{−2U} = 1 − 2U + 2U² − (4/3)U³ + …` against the isotropic Schwarzschild `((1 − U/2)/(1 + U/2))² = 1 − 2U + 2U² − (3/2)U³ + …`: equal through `U²`, apart at `U³` by `1/6` (`6·(−4/3) − 6·(−3/2) = 1`); `e^{2U} = 1 + 2U + 2U² + …` against `(1 + U/2)⁴ = 1 + 2U + (3/2)U² + …`: apart at `U²` by `1/2` (`2·2 − 3 = 1`); the binomial expansion behind the Schwarzschild coefficients: `(1 − 2x + x²)(1 − 2x + 3x² − 4x³)` has `x²`-coefficient `8` and `x³`-coefficient `−12`, read at `x = U/2` as `2` and `−3/2`. Exact integers, decided by the kernel.

C25.name: FRC.Gravity.cover_forcing
C25.doc: 21:A9, 21:C25, 21:C7, 21:C8 — the cover forcing: the apsidal coefficient `2 − β + 2γ` against the PPN-free deficit `3/2` equals the two-face ratio `2` exactly when `2γ − β = 1`, with deviation `(2/3)(2γ − β − 1)`; channel unity `γ = 1` makes the deflection factor `(1 + γ)/2` equal to `1` (the full `4Gm/c²b`) and, together with the forcing, gives `β = 1`, the perihelion factor `(2 + 2γ − β)/3` then `1`. That channel unity forces the spatial bias to equal the temporal one is Lem. isopair's argument, with `γ = 1` the exponential metric's coefficient (`pn_series` carries `B = e^{2U}` against `(1 + U/2)⁴` through `O(U)`). (`FRC.GravML.cover_forcing`, `Theme/Gravity.lean`).

C25.doc: 21:C25, 21:C7, 21:C8, 00:E4 — on every shell: `2γ − β = 1` and `γ = 1` give `β = 1`.

C25.name: FRC.Drift.cover_deviation
C25.doc: 21:C25, 00:E4 — the deviation `2γ − β − 1` vanishes on the triangle.

C26.name: FRC.Relaxation.failure_norm
C26.doc: 21:C26 — the failure tally is the norm of the link mismatch: `(1 − z)(1 − z⁻¹) = 2 − z − z⁻¹` when `z z⁻¹ = 1`; the quadratic free energy of lem:gradient is its chart.

C27.name: FRC.Relaxation.pulse_law
C27.doc: 21:C27 — the pulse law: the quotients `s_k` of `k M = s_k N + r_k` exist for every `k`, rise by at most one per chronon and reach `M` at `k = N`: unit capacity (pre:unit) realises any transfer `M ≤ N` as a balanced sequence of unit pulses, the Christoffel word of lem:isopair, whose mean rate `M/N` is the chart's reading of the current.

C28.name: FRC.Relaxation.terminates
C28.doc: 21:C28 — the registered relaxation terminates: with no current at alignment and a count of at least one quantum per window at every other mismatch (`k μ · M μ ≥ B` for a bound `k`), a link at mismatch at most `n` reaches exact alignment within `budget k n` chronons and stays there.

C28.name: FRC.Relaxation.terminates_basin
C28.doc: 21:C28 — the basin form of `terminates`: the count hypothesis is needed only at the mismatches at or below the start, since the mismatch never grows. A link starting below the antipode of `C_8` or `C_12`, where the exact window count vanishes, is covered: it never reaches the antipode.

C28.name: FRC.Relaxation.drops_within

X1.name: FRC.Grav.closed_chart
X1.doc: 21:X1 — the closed chart on every frame: the drive's full cycle is `p − 1 = 4κ` chronons. Every nonzero residue returns after it (`x = g^m` by the frame's generation, so `x^{4κ} = (g^{4κ})^m = 1`), the generator after no shorter run, and the half cycle is the half-turn `g^{2κ} = −1`. The chart closes at the totality datum: its circumference, the horizon's `2π r_H` in light time, is the full cycle (the primer). The curvature is the chart's reading of the same datum, `Λ = 3/r_H² = 12π/(Ω − 1)` in Planck units with `S = π r_H²` and `Ω = 4S + 1` (the ledger file's check A7, over ℚ with `π` a symbol); the register carries no value for it.

X3.doc: 21:X3, 00:E5, 00:E10, 38:B4 — the drive returns after `n` steps: a function on the cycle read `n` sites on is itself, so a permutation of the cycle has finite order and what it moves comes back.

X4.name: FRC.Static.selection
X4.doc: 21:C11, 21:X4 — character selection: a sequence of grade `0` that also has grade `m` with `g ^ m ≠ 1` vanishes identically — a stationary offset configuration carries no winding demand. On the prime shell `(g^m − 1) f x = 0` with `g^m − 1 ≠ 0` forces `f x = 0` (`FRC.Shell.Prime.mul_eq_zero`).

X4.name: FRC.Drift.gauss_law
X4.doc: 21:C11, 21:C2, 21:X4, 00:E3, 00:E4, 32:C1, 32:X1, 32:C4 — the Gauss law: for antisymmetric link currents `J_xy = −J_yx` on `n` sites, the divergence `Σ_y J_xy` summed over a region `R` equals the flux through its boundary, `Σ_{x ∈ R} Σ_{y ∉ R} J_xy`: the interior links cancel in pairs.

X4.name: FRC.Drift.character_unique
X4.doc: 00:E4, 21:C11, 21:X4 — the exponential reading is the unique scale-covariant one: a function of the drive's steps with the composition law `f (a + b) = f a · f b` and `f 0 = 1` is the character `f a = (f 1)^a`.

X5.name: FRC.Lattice.laplacian_symbol
X5.doc: 21:C15, 21:C10, 21:X5 — on a character `g` with `gⁿ = 1`, the cycle Laplacian acts on `χ_k` as the symbol `g^k + g^{k(n−1)} − 2` (`g^{k(n−1)} = g^{−k}` on the cycle): `(Δ_Φ χ_k)(i) = (g^k + g^{−k} − 2) χ_k(i)`, the dispersion relation `2 − g^k − g^{−k}` of 8:F4, whose chart is `2 − 2 cos k = 4 sin²(k/2)`.

X7.name: FRC.Relaxation.equivalence_cancel
X7.doc: 21:C4, 21:X7 — the equivalence cancellation of the two-shift law: the kick shifts the winding by `m · g` (the `m` of coherent additivity) and the transport moves the registered position by the winding over `m`; the displacement is `g`, and the cardinality cancels inside the law.

X8.name: FRC.Gravity.dilution
X8.doc: 21:X8, 21:C5 — the weakness of gravity as cardinality dilution: with the Planck mass the locality horizon, `m_P = √Ω`, the dimensionless coupling of two masses `m` is `(m/m_P)² = m²/Ω`, small because `Ω` is large. C5's frame covariance is not formal content. (`FRC.Strong.dilution`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P1.name: FRC.Gravity.photon_sphere
P1.doc: 21:P1 — the photon sphere (`prop:shadow`, `rem:exponential`): the impact parameter `b(r) = r e^{2Gm/r}` of the exponential metric satisfies `b(r) ≥ 2e·Gm` for every `r > 0`, with equality exactly at `r = 2Gm` (from `x + 1 ≤ eˣ`, strict off `x = 0`): the photon sphere is at `r_ph = 2Gm`, the critical impact parameter `b_c = 2e·Gm`. (`FRC.Strong.photon_sphere`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P1.name: FRC.Gravity.shadow_bracket
P1.doc: 21:P1 — the shadow and the ringdown against general relativity, bracketed from `e` (nine places) and `√3`: the critical impact parameters `b_c = 2e·Gm` (this work) and `3√3·Gm` (Schwarzschild) have ratio `2e/(3√3)` between `1.0462` and `1.0463` (the shadow `+4.6 %`), and the eikonal ringdown frequency, `∝ 1/b_c`, ratio `3√3/(2e)` between `0.9557` and `0.9558` (`−4.4 %`); the Sgr A* excess `(4e − 6√3) θ_g` at the GRAVITY `θ_g = 5.12 µas` [data, A8] lies between `2.46` and `2.47 µas` (the `2.5 µas` of the text). (`FRC.Strong.shadow_bracket`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P1.name: FRC.Gravity.isco
P1.doc: 21:P1 — the innermost stable circular orbit of the exponential metric (`G = m = 1`, isotropic radius), with the circular-orbit relations of the paper's `prop:isco` taken as given and not formalised (`L² = e^{2/r} r²/(r − 2)` and `E² = e^{−2/r}(r − 1)/(r − 2)` for a circular orbit at `r > 2`): what is proved is that `log L²` has derivative `(r² − 6r + 4)/(r²(r − 2))`, that `r_ISCO = 3 + √5` is the root of `r² − 6r + 4` above `2`, and that `(r − 1)/(r − 2) = r/4` there, so `E² = e^{−2/r} r/4` at the orbit. (`FRC.Strong.isco`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P1.name: FRC.Gravity.isco_efficiency
P1.doc: 21:P1 — the accretion efficiency bracketed: at `r_ISCO = 3 + √5` the orbital energy `E = √(e^{−2/r} r/4)` lies between `0.9452` and `0.9453`, so `1 − E` is between `5.47 %` and `5.48 %` (the text's `5.48 %`), against Schwarzschild's `1 − √(8/9)` between `5.71 %` and `5.72 %`. (`FRC.Strong.isco_efficiency`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P7.name: FRC.Gravity.operational_cut
P7.doc: 21:C12, 21:P7 — the operational cut and the slip core in the substrate coordinate (`G = 1`, `M` in Planck masses, `L = ln Ω`): `r_f = 2M/L` carries `e^{2M/r_f} = Ω` (the round-trip delay's factor); `r_* = √M < r_f` exactly when `M > (L/2)²`, and `r_f < M` exactly when `L > 2` (master E10). (`FRC.Strong.operational_cut`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P8.name: FRC.Gravity.tilt_bracket
P8.doc: 21:C18, 21:P8 — the tilt's numerals at the ledger's `ln Ω = 283.5` (`FRC.Chart.tilt_ledger`, the scale import 00:A7; before 10 October 2026 this name bracketed the tilt at `281`): `−π²/283.5` between `−0.03482` and `−0.03481` (the row's `−0.0348`), `+0.07σ` from Planck 2018's `−0.0351 ± 0.0042` [data], and `½ ln Ω` excluded at `8.2σ`.

P2.name: FRC.Gravity.preferred_frame_scale
P2.doc: 21:P2, 21:C10 — the numeral behind the preferred-frame scale: the drive's signature is `O(1/√Ω)` (the paper's `α₁, α₂`), and at the scale import's `Ω = 1.3 × 10¹²³` (00:A7) this lies between `2.7` and `2.8 × 10⁻⁶²` (the row's `3 × 10⁻⁶²`). (`FRC.Strong.preferred_frame_scale`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P3.name: FRC.Gravity.floor_value
P3.doc: 21:P3 — the floor `a₀ = cH₀/2π` at the entailed `H₀ = 67.4`: between `1.04` and `1.05 × 10⁻¹⁰ m s⁻²`, `13 %` low and `0.7σ` against the fitted `1.20 ± 0.24 × 10⁻¹⁰`.

P4.name: FRC.Gravity.crossover_limits
P4.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4 — the crossover `g_obs = g_N/(1 − e^{−√x})`, `x = g_N/a₀`, squeezed: with `t = √x > 0`, `1 ≤ t/(1 − e^{−t})`, and `t/(1 − e^{−t}) ≤ 1/(1 − 3t/4)` for `t ≤ 1`; and the Tully–Fisher algebra is exact: `v² = g_obs r` with `g_obs = √(g_N a₀)`, `g_N = GM/r²`, gives `v⁴ = GMa₀`. (`FRC.Strong.crossover_limits`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P4.name: FRC.Gravity.crossover_newton_limit
P4.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4 — the Newtonian limit: `1 − e^{−t} → 1` as `t → ∞`, so `g_obs/g_N → 1` for `x → ∞`. (`FRC.Strong.crossover_newton_limit`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P4.name: FRC.Gravity.registration_root
P4.doc: 21:C19, 21:P4 — the registration root: for `0 < w < 1` the quadratic `wη² − 2η + w = 0` (rational in the paper's `w`, here over `ℝ`) has exactly the roots `(1 ∓ √(1 − w²))/w`; the smaller, `η = (1 − √(1 − w²))/w`, lies in `(0, 1)` and the larger exceeds `1`, so the in-`(0, 1)` root that fixes the resolved fraction `f = 1 − η^a` is unique. (`FRC.Strong.registration_root`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P4.name: FRC.Gravity.interpolant_discriminant
P4.doc: 21:P4 — the discriminant against the simple interpolant at `g_N = 5a₀`: the crossover `ν(5) = 1/(1 − e^{−√5})` lies between `1.11966` and `1.11967`, the simple interpolant `ν_s(5) = 1/2 + √(1/4 + 1/5)` between `1.17082` and `1.17083`, so they part by between `0.0511` and `0.0512` in `g_obs/g_N` (the text's `0.05`). (`FRC.Strong.interpolant_discriminant`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P5.name: FRC.Gravity.running_floor
P5.doc: 21:P5 — the running floor: if the floor is read at every redshift on the registered rate, `a₀(z) = cH(z)/2π`, and the deep regime's `v⁴ = GMa₀` holds at fixed baryonic mass `M`, then `a₀(z)/a₀(0) = H(z)/H(0) = E(z)` and the Tully–Fisher zero-point evolves as `v(z)/v(0) = E(z)^{1/4}`; that the floor tracks the registered rate is the row's realisation clause (00:D5), not formal content. (`FRC.Chart.running_floor`, `Theme/Chart.lean`, the master's 00:P1).

P6.name: FRC.Gravity.pn_series
P6.doc: 21:C8, 21:P6, 21:C7 — the post-Newtonian inputs as Taylor brackets on `|U| ≤ 1/2`: the exponential metric's `A = e^{−2U}`, `B = e^{2U}` against the isotropic Schwarzschild `A_S = ((1 − U/2)/(1 + U/2))²`, `B_S = (1 + U/2)⁴` satisfy `|A − A_S − U³/6| ≤ 3U⁴` and `|B − B_S − U²/2| ≤ 3|U|³`: the single-potential inputs consumed by C23 coincide through first post-Newtonian order (`A` to `O(U²)`, `B` to `O(U)`) and part at 2PN with `δA = U³/6`, `δB = U²/2`; the two-body superposition of C23 is the package's. (`FRC.Strong.pn_series`, `Theme/Strong.lean`).

P6.name: FRC.Drift.pn_coefficients
P6.doc: 21:C8, 21:C23, 21:P6, 00:E4 — `e^{−2U} = 1 − 2U + 2U² − (4/3)U³ + …` against the isotropic Schwarzschild `((1 − U/2)/(1 + U/2))² = 1 − 2U + 2U² − (3/2)U³ + …`: equal through `U²`, apart at `U³` by `1/6` (`6·(−4/3) − 6·(−3/2) = 1`); `e^{2U} = 1 + 2U + 2U² + …` against `(1 + U/2)⁴ = 1 + 2U + (3/2)U² + …`: apart at `U²` by `1/2` (`2·2 − 3 = 1`); the binomial expansion behind the Schwarzschild coefficients: `(1 − 2x + x²)(1 − 2x + 3x² − 4x³)` has `x²`-coefficient `8` and `x³`-coefficient `−12`, read at `x = U/2` as `2` and `−3/2`. Exact integers, decided by the kernel.
